snippet.title: Paladin HC - Howitzer Commander Gamplay - Steam Wishlist Trailer
snippet.description:
We're an independent game studio developing Paladin HC, and we're excited to share our journey with you!

Take command of a 3D Paladin self-propelled howitzer and carry out missions based on historical military operations.

We're making steady progress, and there's more to come! Our first dev blog is now available, and the demo is coming soon.

Your support means the world to our small team. Add Paladin HC to your Steam Wishlist, read our first dev blog, and follow us on this journey!

🔗 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5295290/Paladin_HC/

Stay tuned for more updates!

#PaladinHC #IndieGame #MilitarySimulation #GameDev #IndieGames
